status: Functional distribution corrected; real hardware operation NOT validated
findings: The previous four-hole hollow valve box did not model partitions, valve seats or closures; its literal pressure-volume interpretation joined P,A,B,T.
Two chamber pipes per cylinder are sufficient when a real distributor alternates admission and exhaust through each pipe. A/B are bidirectional, P/T are separate supply/exhaust.
The new 3D insert is an explicitly symbolic four-valve functional diagram, not a dimensioned pressure manifold. Channel radii and illustrated gate movements do not specify manufacturing dimensions.
B pipes now take a shorter route around the plenums and below the crosshead plane. No pipe has been removed without preserving its function.
External A/B pipe volumes were absent from displayed chamber volumes. They are now included as connected-volume lower bounds.
The unchanged global simulation and sizing estimates still omit actual valve-flow dynamics, residual filling/compression and this clearance contribution. Their power/rpm are unvalidated scenarios.

ports.T: Spent steam to condenser, then liquid water returns via pumps
ports.A: Outer/non-rod chamber: admission PA, exhaust AT
ports.B: Rod-side chamber: admission PB, exhaust BT

rules: No chamber inlet and exhaust may overlap in this commanded model.
P must never be connected to T via an open chamber.
Timing follows actual articulated-linkage movement, with assumed 30% stroke cutoff and release after 98.5% expansion stroke.
No cam, valve actuator, lead/lap, compression event, leakage or timing tolerance has yet been designed.

formulas.displacement: V_swept = area × stroke; adding pipe volume does not increase displacement

remaining_engine_work: Dimension and select the distributor architecture; a slide valve is an alternative, not a component already designed.
Design common-shaft-synchronised actuation and stop/failure states.
Solve transient chamber mass, energy and actual steam properties, with external/internal dead volumes and valve discharge coefficients.
Provide specified chamber drains, rod glands, oil separation/lubrication, thermal clearances and rated joints.
Rebuild and verify the stronger mechanical CAD; validate pressure strength, fatigue and hot/cold properties.
